lines.t: Verse 1
In a garden where the wild winds blew
I was searching for a life I never knew
Petals falling from a heart worn thin
Till Your light came breaking in
Through the shadows, through the gray
You called my hidden seeds by name
Pre-Chorus
From the dust You raised me up to bloom
Turned my sorrow into sweet perfume
Chorus
YahuShua, You’re the Rose in the rain
Color in my life through the joy and pain
You make beauty grow from broken ground
Now my roots in Your love are found
YahuShua, let my life unfold
Like a field of grace in red and gold
Verse 2
I was drifting like a seed alone
No direction, no place called home
Carried by the winds of my own ways
Lost inside a thousand yesterdays
But Your voice like morning dew
Softly spoke and pulled me through
Pre-Chorus
Every dry place starts to come alive
When Your living water floods inside
Chorus
YahuShua, You’re the Rose in the rain
Color in my life through the joy and pain
You make beauty grow from broken ground
Now my roots in Your love are found
YahuShua, let my life unfold
Like a field of grace in red and gold
Bridge
Even thorns can’t steal Your plan
You hold every petal in Your hand
What was buried now will rise
By Your truth and by Your light
Final Chorus
YahuShua, You’re the bloom of my days
Every breath is singing out Your praise
From the ashes, life begins again
In Your mercy, I remain
YahuShua, let my heart be known
As a garden where Your love has grown
Outro
Now I’m rooted, now I stand
Held forever in Your hand
